title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Neon marks GDM's full return as a Frontier Lab
author: swyx .ai
description: November 24, 2026 — Neon beats Astra and Fable on LiveBench and cuts Theo’s TS Rust benchmark runtime by 48.6%.
summary: Three months ago, shortly after the Demis/Dean/etc departures , and with disappointing progress on Gemini 3 models, people had publicly given up on Google DeepMind as a frontier lab. Today, apologies are being issued , and Neon is the talk of the town!
takeaways: AI Twitter Recap Frontier Models as Research Engines: VP ≠ VNP, Protein Design and 948 Kernel Bugs VP ≠ VNP, posted by two labs : An Anthropic GitHub repo reportedly contains a proof by an internal Claude research model that VP ≠ VNP.

GPT-6 protein design, wet-lab validated : OpenAI released a preprint showing GPT-6 models designing new protein shapes and sequences through reasoning and code, without specialized bio models ( @OpenAI ).

Developer tooling : Google shipped an experimental anti-slop frontend-design skill for Neon ( @_philschmid ) and made eight Workspace MCP servers plus gwscli generally available, with 5,000 requests/day free per product ( @_philschmid ).
